summary: Searches a strided string table (108 bytes per entry) for a string matching the caller-supplied argument. The search string is first copied into a local buffer and passed through sub_589901, which normalizes it for comparison. Entry count and table base are read from this+0x8 and this+0xC. Returns the matching entry's index, or -1 when the table is empty or no entry matches.

operations.description: Copy the caller-supplied string into a local 64-byte buffer.
Normalize/transform the copied search string in place via sub_589901 before comparison.
Guard on entry count at this+0x8: when count <= 0 the table is empty and the function returns -1 immediately.
Initialize the match index counter to 0.
Iterate over entries starting at this+0xC advancing 108 bytes per entry, bounded by the entry count at this+0x8.
Test each table entry against the normalized search string with StringTableLookup; the loop stops on a match.
Return -1 when the count is exhausted without any entry matching.
Return the index of the first entry that matches the normalized search string.
